content.short: Para is a non-custodial embedded wallet SDK using MPC, with email, phone and social login.
content.description: Para is an embedded wallet SDK that uses MPC to give apps non-custodial wallets with email, phone or social login. It supports EVM, Solana and Cosmos networks, covering more than a hundred chains, and is free up to 1,200 monthly active users. Para counts over 200 companies building on it and 15 million end users, and holds SOC 2 Type II controls. Authentication and wallet provisioning arrive together, so a fintech does not assemble them separately.
